a folded stack of evening papers

secret.description: Lavinia Thorndike is with Abraham Sirkin in the Roof Garden from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.

people.name: Constance Stannard
people.relationshipToVictim: a childhood friend of the victim from the same block

secret.description: Constance Stannard slips out to the Street from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

people.name: Emilio Vitale
people.role: a dentist with rooms on the third floor

secret.description: Emilio Vitale meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 9:00 PM and asks for money.
Pasquale Grasso is alone with Bella Hurwitz in the Service Stairs from 10:30 PM, and kills Bella Hurwitz at 10:30 PM.

coverSecret.description: Pasquale Grasso is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.

motive.description: was about to be exposed by the victim

people.name: Abraham Sirkin
people.role: a bookmaker in a small way

secret.description: Abraham Sirkin is with Lavinia Thorndike in the Roof Garden from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.
Nunzio Tramonti drinks alone in the Bar from 10:30 PM to 11:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

method.name: strangling with a cord
method.bodyEvidence: A ligature furrow across the throat. Three fibres of hemp in the skin.

Bella Hurwitz was found on the Service Stairs. The coroner puts death between 10:00 PM and 10:30 PM. A ligature furrow across the throat. Three fibres of hemp in the skin.
A length of sash cord is missing from the Kitchen. A cut end of the same hemp is still tied to the fitting it was taken from.
Rain began at 7:00 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
Heinrich Obermann says Constance Stannard came in off the street at 7:30 PM with a soaked coat, so Constance Stannard was outside at 7:00 PM.
Nunzio Tramonti says Emilio Vitale came in off the street at 7:30 PM with a soaked coat, so Emilio Vitale was outside at 7:00 PM.
Lavinia Thorndike says Pasquale Grasso came in off the street at 10:00 PM with a soaked coat, so Pasquale Grasso was outside at 9:30 PM.
The passenger elevator was out of order from 9:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Anyone changing floors in that time used the service stairs.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Bella Hurwitz's sleeve; Bella Hurwitz was on the stairs at 9:30 PM.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Emilio Vitale's sleeve; Emilio Vitale was on the stairs at 9:30 PM.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Abraham Sirkin's sleeve; Abraham Sirkin was on the stairs at 9:30 PM.
Pasquale Grasso's papers do not hold up. Two signatures in the guest register, a month apart, are in different hands.
Found in the Front Desk: A draft codicil in Bella Hurwitz's hand striking Constance Stannard out of the will, dated last Tuesday and unsigned.
Heinrich Obermann says Bella Hurwitz told Constance Stannard the lawyer was coming Thursday and that the arrangement would be changed.
Found in the Front Desk: A typed page of dates and sums in Bella Hurwitz's file, headed with Pasquale Grasso's name.
Lavinia Thorndike says Bella Hurwitz told Pasquale Grasso that the story would run whether Pasquale Grasso liked it or not.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A promissory note for $4,000 signed by Abraham Sirkin, endorsed to Bella Hurwitz, three months past due.
Heinrich Obermann says Bella Hurwitz told Abraham Sirkin that Friday was the end of it, one way or the other.
Found in the Victim's Suite: Three letters in Bella Hurwitz's hand to a woman Nunzio Tramonti is engaged to, kept in the drawer, the last one opened.
Friedrich Kreuzer says Nunzio Tramonti told Bella Hurwitz to keep away, loud enough to turn heads.
